name: Birth Certificate
description: Information and guidance for obtaining a birth certificate.
descriptionHi: जन्म प्रमाण पत्र प्राप्त करने की जानकारी और मार्गदर्शन।
applicationSteps: Contact your local Gram Panchayat or designated registration office.
Confirm the applicable registration procedure.
Submit the required information and supporting documents.
Follow up with the responsible office.

name: Death Certificate
description: Guidance about death registration and obtaining a death certificate.
descriptionHi: मृत्यु पंजीकरण और मृत्यु प्रमाण पत्र प्राप्त करने की जानकारी।
requiredDocuments: Medical cause of death certificate, where applicable
applicationSteps: Contact the local registrar or designated Panchayat office.
Confirm the documents required for the case.
Submit the death registration details.
Collect or track the certificate through the responsible office.

name: Residence Certificate Guidance
description: Guidance on finding the appropriate authority and procedure for a residence certificate.
descriptionHi: निवास प्रमाण पत्र के लिए संबंधित कार्यालय और प्रक्रिया की जानकारी।
applicationSteps: Contact the local Tehsil or designated state service centre.
Check the state-specific application requirements.
Submit the application and supporting documents.
Follow the application status through the responsible authority.

name: Water Supply Information
description: Guidance for reporting local drinking water supply problems.
descriptionHi: स्थानीय पेयजल आपूर्ति की समस्या दर्ज कराने की जानकारी।
applicationSteps: Contact the Gram Panchayat office.
Describe the location and nature of the water supply issue.
Note any complaint reference provided.
Follow up with the responsible local authority.

name: Sanitation Services
description: Information on local sanitation and waste-management services.
descriptionHi: स्थानीय स्वच्छता और कचरा प्रबंधन सेवाओं की जानकारी।
applicationSteps: Contact the Gram Panchayat office.
Provide the location and details of the issue.
Ask which local department handles the request.
Follow up with the responsible authority.
